objects.taxonomy_description: Elongated bicycle with two seats and two sets of pedals arranged in tandem (one behind the other). The frame is significantly longer than a standard bicycle (approximately 2 meters), with an extended top tube connecting the front and rear triangles. Two handlebars are present: the front rider steers, the rear rider has fixed or adjustable handlebars. Both riders have individual saddles positioned at different heights along the frame. The wheels are standard bicycle size (26-28 inches). The overall silhouette is a stretched bicycle profile with two distinct rider positions.
